title: SKAB run valve1/1
note: Real data from the SKAB pump rig. The shaded band is the fault labelled by SKAB.

alerts.title: Vibration B rose 2.9σ, not yet confirmed
reasons: Only vibration B moved; no related signal confirms it yet.
A real fault and a sensor offset look the same at this point.
alerts.cause: Mechanical change at the pump: imbalance, looseness or cavitation. Could also be a sensor offset.
alerts.action: Check the vibration b reading against a local gauge (a two-minute check). If it agrees, treat this as a machine fault.
alerts.truth: Overlaps a fault labelled in SKAB.

alerts.title: Vibration B sensor looks faulty: erratic signal (loose contact or interference)
reasons: The reading became erratic (4.1x normal variability, jumps 6.3x the largest healthy step).
The related vibration A signal stayed calm, which a real machine change would rarely allow.
alerts.cause: Instrument problem, not the machine: wiring, connector, power or calibration.
alerts.action: Check the vibration b transmitter and its wiring before sending mechanical maintenance. Treat its readings as unreliable until it is checked.
alerts.truth: No labelled fault here: this alarm counts as a false alarm in our metrics.
